objective: Test whether a learned low-rank cross-space compatibility function identifies the correct RWKV state over matched-donor and layer-permuted controls on an exact source-and-donor-component-disjoint 176/44 split of the 220 already-authorized open native rows.

frozen_inputs.candidate: output-inactive address-keyed learned-write candidate used by the signed geometry screen and causal mechanics preflight

feature_capture.query: detached projected slot value fixed from the target write and repeated over target answer positions
feature_capture.positive_state: answer-position addressed RWKV read with the target recurrent state
negative_states: matched-donor recurrent state with target projected carrier
cyclic layer-permuted target recurrent state with target projected carrier
feature_capture.reduction: mean over answer positions, retain all 42 layers and state width 32

crossfit_split.algorithm: Build the undirected graph of all source-to-matched-donor edges, hash-order its connected components using the selection salt, and use deterministic subset-sum to select whole components totaling exactly 44 heldout rows.

offline_training.head: per-layer identity-plus-rank4 residual maps for query and state followed by cosine compatibility
offline_training.initialization: down Gaussian std 0.02; up zero; exact identity maps
offline_training.objective: mean relu(0.2-correct+donor) plus mean relu(0.2-correct+layer_permuted), reduced over train rows and layers

stopping_rule.pass: May design a separately preregistered causal training run that uses the compatibility score as a bounded recurrent correction gate; generation remains blocked.
stopping_rule.fail: Retire this compatibility family and do not run another native generation benchmark.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the strength holdout.
